lines.text: War broke out with the Philistines at Gezer, where Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim.
Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, in another battle with the Philistines.
At Gath there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-two in all.
When the man taunted Israel, Abishai the son of David's brother Shimei killed him.
These descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
